# shoppablecn

> E-commerce UI primitives for shadcn/ui. Product cards, shoppable hotspot images, and quick-buy overlays. Install via the shadcn CLI — you own the code.

## Installation

Install individual components via the shadcn CLI:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/product-card.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/quick-options.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/hotspot-image.json
```

Each command installs the component source, its shared dependencies (`types.ts`, `utils.ts`), and any required shadcn primitives automatically.

## Components

### ProductCard

Flexible e-commerce product card with three layouts and two variant modes.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/product-card.json`

Also installs: `quick-options.tsx` (used internally for overlay mode), `types.ts`, `utils.ts`

Docs: https://docs.shoppablecn.dev/docs/product-card

### QuickOptions

Slide-up overlay for variant selection. Supports 6 option types: swatch, pills, select, slider, checkbox, radio.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/quick-options.json`

Also installs: `types.ts`, `utils.ts`

Docs: https://docs.shoppablecn.dev/docs/quick-options

### HotspotImage

Image container with percentage-positioned hotspot pins. Each pin opens a Radix Popover with custom content — a ProductCard, HotspotTooltip, HotspotLink, or any JSX.

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://shoppablecn.dev/r/hotspot-image.json`

Also installs: `hotspot-pin.tsx`, `hotspot-tooltip.tsx`, `hotspot-link.tsx`, `types.ts`, `utils.ts`

Docs: https://docs.shoppablecn.dev/docs/hotspot-image

## TypeScript Types

All public types are in `types.ts`. Key types:

```ts
type Currency = "EUR" | "USD" | "GBP" | "SEK"

type Price = {
  amount: number      // in minor units (cents) — e.g. 4900 = €49.00
  currency: Currency
  compareAt?: number  // optional strikethrough price, also in minor units
}

type ProductImage = {
  src: string
  alt: string
}

type Product = {
  id: string
  title: string
  description?: string
  category?: string
  images: ProductImage[]  // must have at least one entry; first is default
  price: Price
  rating?: { value: number; count: number }  // value: 0–5
  badge?: { label: string; variant?: "default" | "sale" | "new" }
  href?: string
  variants?: ProductVariant[]
}

type VariantOption = {
  label: string
  value: string
  swatch?: string    // CSS color value, used when type="swatch"
  disabled?: boolean
}

type ProductVariant = {
  id: string
  name: string
  type: "swatch" | "pills" | "select" | "slider" | "checkbox" | "radio"
  required?: boolean
  options: VariantOption[]
  sliderConfig?: { min: number; max: number; step: number; unit?: string }
}

type SelectedVariants = Record<string, string | string[] | number>

type ProductCardLayout = "vertical" | "horizontal" | "horizontal-detailed"
type ProductCardVariantsMode = "none" | "overlay"

type ProductCardProps = {
  product: Product
  layout?: ProductCardLayout          // default: "vertical"
  variants?: ProductCardVariantsMode  // default: "none"
  slideshowControls?: "arrows" | "dots" | "both" | "none"  // default: "both"
  showWishlist?: boolean
  isWishlisted?: boolean
  showRating?: boolean
  showQuickView?: boolean
  onAddToCart?: (args: { productId: string; selectedVariants?: SelectedVariants }) => void
  onWishlistToggle?: (productId: string) => void
  onQuickView?: (productId: string) => void
  className?: string
}

type HotspotImageProps = {
  src: string
  alt: string
  width: number   // natural width in pixels
  height: number  // natural height in pixels
  children: React.ReactNode  // HotspotPin components
  className?: string
}

type HotspotPinProps = {
  x: number        // horizontal position as % of image width (0–100)
  y: number        // vertical position as % of image height (0–100)
  variant?: "plus" | "dot"  // default: "plus"
  label?: string   // aria-label for the pin button
  children: React.ReactNode  // popover content
  className?: string
}

type HotspotTooltipProps = {
  title: string
  description: string
  className?: string
}

type HotspotLinkProps = {
  label: string
  href: string
  target?: React.HTMLAttributeAnchorTarget
  className?: string
}
```

## Key Constraints

- **Prices are in minor units (cents).** `amount: 4900` with `currency: "EUR"` renders as €49.00. Never pass decimal amounts.
- **`currency` is a union, not a free string.** Valid values: `"EUR" | "USD" | "GBP" | "SEK"`.
- **`images` must have at least one entry.** The first image is always the default displayed image.
- **`variants="overlay"` requires `product.variants` to have entries.** If `product.variants` is empty or undefined, it falls back to a regular Add to Cart button.

## Composition Patterns

### ProductCard inside HotspotPin

HotspotPin accepts any JSX as children. ProductCard renders correctly inside a pin's popover:

```tsx
<HotspotImage src="/scene.jpg" width={1920} height={1080} alt="Living room">
  <HotspotPin x={35} y={60} label="View sofa">
    <ProductCard product={sofa} layout="vertical" variants="none" />
  </HotspotPin>
</HotspotImage>
```

### HotspotPin content types

Three preset content components ship with HotspotImage:

```tsx
// Informational tooltip
<HotspotPin x={20} y={40} label="Wall art details">
  <HotspotTooltip title="Framed Canvas" description="Hand-painted, 60×80cm." />
</HotspotPin>

// Simple link
<HotspotPin x={70} y={30} label="Shop collection">
  <HotspotLink label="View collection" href="/collections/art" />
</HotspotPin>

// Any custom JSX also works
<HotspotPin x={50} y={50} label="Custom content">
  <div className="p-4">
    <p>Any content here</p>
  </div>
</HotspotPin>
```
